author: KEXP
description: Finland's @oranssipazuzu offer psychedelic, avant-garde black metal in our latest in-studio session. With host Tanner Ellison, the band share a performance of "Violetu" and more.
title: Oranssi Pazuzu peforms "Violetu" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Oranssi Pazuzu performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded May 7, 2026.

Songs:
Voitelu 00:40
Muuntautuja 05:49
Kuulen ääniä maan alta 10:26
Bioalkemisti 17:36

Jun-His (Juho Vanhanen) - Vocals, Guitar
Ontto (Toni Hietamaki) - Bass, Synth
Ikon (Niko Lehdontie) - Guitar, Sampler, Synth
Evill (Ville Leppilahti) - Keyboard, Effects, Vocals

Host: Tanner Ellison
